spiritual_reading.full_translation:
Within the whole span of ordered existence there are three universal pathways of communication, extending from the lowest obscurity up to the highest illumination.

The first pathway is the inmost dependence by which all higher operative forces in the ordered heavens are held in connection with their ultimates. Those higher forces are as though cast down and bound in the lowest degree, because the lowest degree is the plane where interiors are terminated in outward form, and where what is living is set into an external covering and an inert remainder.

For when the Divine vital source brought the ordered heavens into form, it provided them with an ultimate basis by casting beneath them their lowest terminations.

Thus the higher degrees are chiefly living will and living understanding; but the lowest degrees are chiefly outward effect and what is dead when separated from interior life. Therefore the Divine fixed the higher forces to their ultimates and sealed their connection there, so that when life is awakened from the fullness of the lowest plane it may be drawn up entirely into the higher origins that stand rooted in those ultimates; and so that the life rising there may be purified.

Yet whatever cannot be conjoined with the purified life, and whatever is rejected as unfit in the act of purification, is let fall again by those same general communications, sinking down into the lowest underside.

This is the first universal communication: descent from higher forces into ultimates, and return from ultimates into higher forces.

The second universal communication is the exchange between higher ordered intelligences and the formed perceptions in the lowest degree. From higher states there is influx down into the various patterns of perception that grow in the external mind, and from those perceptions a responsive life rises back into higher intelligences. Moreover, both living influence and residual byproduct from higher operations also descend again into those perceptions by a regulated channel.

The third universal communication is the exchange between the powers ruling in intermediate regions and the various bodily life-forms in the lowest degree, which are joined together in mutual dependence. The power and vitality gathered from bodily life are distributed among the intermediate rulers in many varied forms, and the higher powers draw upward whatever can be raised through ordered channels.

Yet refuse as well—craving, evil in act, and kindled hostility that increase among the higher when they fall out of order—is poured down by their several communications into the lowest plane, and is discharged into human life and into other remaining living affections there. When higher things wash impurity, stench, and poison down into the lower forms, the lower forms in turn are driven into greater craving, hostility, and mutual harm, because they are acted upon from above by those that should have governed them for good.

Attend also to the general governing system that measures and disposes outward states. It does not stand by an origin rooted in the lowest degree as its proper base; its origin is held in connection with the totality. Yet it still receives a kind of life from the power and vitality that rise from the lowest plane through ordered communications into intermediate degrees; and it also takes something from the channels that carry upward into higher heavens beyond it.

But if this governing system has no proper root in the lowest plane, from where did it acquire such authority that it rules over external perception and bodily condition? For it is observed that outward lot—gain and loss, sickness and health—seems to come to a person under the general determinations that attend one’s entry into life.

What was said remains true: it has no proper root there. It is held in place by another bond. For when the Divine vital source established the heavens and the intermediate degrees, it bound their origins into the ultimates beneath them, into the dead remainders stripped away as their supporting plane; but when it established this general governing system, it did not bind its origin into those ultimates. Instead it bound its origin by the vast most-external general receptacle of knowledge, so that its authority would stand upon generalities.

And when divine revelation came forth in living representation and brought purified light out through all higher degrees, the undivine material element present within the ruling powers spurted up against that manifestation. It rose to seize it, but could not reach it; and therefore it fell back down into the underside. After falling from higher things, it separated into three distinct portions.

One portion attached itself to that general governing system, another sank into the lowest plane itself, and another flowed into the most-external generality. By means of the portion that attached to the governing system, an induced bond was established within outward perception and bodily life, and therefore that governing system received authority and became dominant over the varieties of external perception and bodily state.

Through the quality of the undivine element that descended onto the governing system, a bond was established within outward perception; and by means of the gross rejected products that fell into the lowest plane, another bond was established within bodily life.

For this reason the determinations of that governing system obtained authority over outward perception and bodily state: through the induced bond of evil that fell down, and through the induced bond of what is malformed and rejected that came forth in the lowest degree.

But the other universal communications that the Divine fixed in the lowest plane, through which the living soul of basic principles rises into higher states, are not conjoined to that governing system. Rather, the powers dependent on that governing system seize those communications and divert them to themselves.

This lesson also sets out a general pattern: there is the communication from intermediate degrees down to the ultimates, and there is the communication by which the governing system’s origin is held in the most external generality—these together forming one complex; then there is the communication from higher intelligences to outward perceptions; and there is the communication established through rejected malformed products within bodily life, by which even the generating sources of those malformed products in higher regions remain intertwined with the bodily plane. Here the sequence becomes fragmented and does not yield a fully coherent spiritual chain.

Further, the preeminence of these communications is that much life rises from the lowest plane in its wide diversity, and the Divine draws it upward. The Divine fastens these pathways from higher powers and binds them into ultimates. They are the origins of the whole dominion by which the life of the living soul is raised, coming up from the entire natural degree in all its exterior states.

After that first great origin comes the origin of outward perceptions, conjoined to higher ordered intelligences and their established forms. For there also much life rises from formed perception and from the whole structure of deliverance and conjunction, and it is drawn upward as if a great host.

What follows concerning lesser measures and unequal distribution becomes broken and only partly intelligible. The sense that can be drawn is that the pathways pertaining to outward perceptions are spread widely through the whole lowest degree in lesser and greater measure, while the pathway pertaining to human bodily life is not equally present everywhere, but is limited to one region and sparse even there; this portion remains uncertain because the wording is damaged.

You have been instructed that these origins are bound together in ordered connections. They stir one another, and they draw life from one another by the operation of higher powers, which sets in motion the common nature dwelling within them all.

But when the undivine material element within these interconnected forms is crushed and stripped away, that same element turns upon the very members in which it was lodged, distorts their faculties, and drives them into mutual overthrow and conflict; the ending is broken, yet it points to escalating disorder among the connected members as that element acts within them.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Coherent through ¶17 as a single teaching on three universal communications of descent/return, purification, and the intrusion of an external governing order; strongest where the three pathways are defined and where the governing system’s abnormal bonding is explained. Coherence stumbles at ¶18 (broken syntax) and especially ¶22 (severely corrupt), after which the text regains unity in ¶23–24 by returning to mutual linkage and the destabilizing action of the undivine material element.

findings.diagnosis: Clean chapter incipit in correspondential mode: establishes a triadic functional structure (three conduits spanning the whole zone).
findings.evidence: Text: “There are three conduits that exist through the entire zone, from the abyss to its heights.” The spiritual reading reports the chapter “coherent through ¶17” and treats ¶1 as an opening thesis that the rest of the chapter elaborates by defining three pathways.

findings.diagnosis: Coherent correspondential substrate: ‘roots/conduits’ explained by function (binding, ascent, purification, descent of waste). No jurisdictional lists; the imagery works as a hydraulic/circulatory mechanism.
findings.evidence: Text: “earth below is the ‘stripping off’, the garment and the body…”, “so that when life comes up… it can be entirely drawn up… And also, all life can be purified in that place”, “the waste… will be let fall…”. The reading does not stumble here; it can paraphrase by function (ultimates, ascent/return, purification), which indicates the spiritual sense arises from what the conduits DO rather than who governs them.

findings.diagnosis: Still mainly correspondential: second and third conduits are functional exchanges (temples↔trees; firmaments↔flesh). However the repeated fivefold taxonomic markers (“five shapes of tree,” “five worlds of flesh”) begin a systematizing register that pressures the functional narrative.
findings.evidence: Text: “to the five shapes of tree…”, “to the five worlds of flesh…”. The spiritual reading has to generalize these as “sufficient varieties,” a mild sign that the number is functioning as a schematic inventory rather than arising organically from the conduit-mechanism. Yet the conduit logic (descent/return, life/residue) still holds together, so removal would not improve flow here.

findings.diagnosis: Insertion into a functional ‘three conduits’ lesson: an astrological/authority digression introduces a new problem-frame (“wheel of the stars… signs of the zodiac… wealth/poverty… sickness/health”) and a new anchoring myth (“root… bound… by the sea giant”). This is not teaching by conduit-function but by cosmic governance/authority, and it derails the triadic structure by creating an additional ‘root’ problem unrelated to the three defined conduits.
findings.evidence: Text abruptly pivots: “Still, look at the wheel of the stars!” (¶10) and frames authority: “from where did the stars and signs of the zodiac find this authority? They became masters…” (¶11), then resolves it with a governance-bond: “he bound the root of the wheel by the sea giant” (¶12). The spiritual reading must recast this as “general governing system” and abstract “sea giant” as “most-external general receptacle of knowledge,” explicitly noting the nuance is “uncertain.” This is exactly the stumble pattern of an overlay that doesn’t yield spiritual sense by function without heavy paraphrase.
findings.scope: Excise ¶10-12 in full: “Still, look at the wheel of the stars! … he bound the root of the wheel by the sea giant.”

findings.diagnosis: Expansion at a seam: mythic episode of named agents (“Ambassador,” “Living Spirit,” “Father of Life”) and etiological explanation for zodiacal authority via ‘Matter’ splitting into three parts, including “Sin” and “abortions.” This continues the astrological governance thread rather than the conduit-mechanism, and it compounds the digression with secondary myth-terminology that the spiritual reading has to allegorize aggressively (“Ambassador” as “revelation,” “abortions” as “malformed products”).
findings.evidence: Text: “when [the] Ambassador came… Matter… spurted out… separated out into three parts” (¶13); “The first part fell to the wheel…” (¶14); “by means of the abortions… another root…” (¶15); “root of Sin… root of the abortions…” (¶16). The reading reports strong coherence up to ¶17 only by absorbing this as part of an “intrusion of an external governing order,” which is a conceptual retrofit; the text itself has already left the conduit lesson and is now doing origin-myth for astral domination.
findings.scope: Excise ¶13-16 in full: “And when [the] Ambassador came… they fell to the ground.”

findings.diagnosis: Return toward the original conduit topic (conduits bound in earths for ascent of ‘soul of the elements’), but the sentence is now tethered to the excised astrological block via polemic (“not bound to the wheel… plundered… by the powers on the wheel”). This paragraph is structurally a bridge back, and its anti-wheel clause is a residual stitch from the overlay.
findings.evidence: Text contains a clean correspondential core: “other conduits… bound in the earths… the soul of the elements comes up through to the heavens” but also a dependence on the zodiac overlay: “those… are not bound to the wheel… plundered… by the powers on the wheel”. The spiritual reading tracks this as a “shift” and treats it as a contrast with the governing system. If ¶10-16 are removed, the anti-wheel clause becomes an unmotivated reference.
findings.scope: Excise only the wheel-dependent stitch within ¶17: “those (conduits) are not bound to the wheel. Rather, they are plundered from them by the powers on the wheel, that hang from it.” Retain: “However, the[se] other conduits that [the] Living Spirit has bound in the e[a]rths, they that the soul of the elements comes up through to the heavens;”

findings.diagnosis: Damaged and also systematizing recapitulation that no longer matches the chapter’s own triadic definition. It tries to re-tally the teaching (“prototype… The first… That is only one. So, the other… The third…”) but the count and categories are confused, and the syntax breaks midstream. This looks like a later attempt to harmonize ‘three conduits’ with the inserted ‘wheel-root/sea giant/abortions’ materials.
findings.evidence: Text: “you have told us about the prototype… The first is… firmaments to the earths, and… wheel to the sea giant. That is only one. So, the other root is… temples… The third is bound by means of the abortions…” then breaks off. The spiritual reading explicitly stumbles: “Here the sequence becomes fragmented and does not yield a fully coherent spiritual chain,” and notes “Text breaks mid-sentence… forced and incomplete.” This is both physical corruption and conceptual corruption caused by incompatible schemas.
findings.scope: Annotate ¶18 as a corrupt schematic recapitulatory seam (prototype/tally) likely attempting to integrate the ‘wheel/sea giant/abortions’ overlay with the earlier conduit teaching; do not excise because the surviving text is too fragmentary to separate cleanly.

findings.diagnosis: Clean return to correspondential substrate: conduits as ‘roots’ by which life ascends from the whole earth; then a second root of trees bound to temples; imagery is functional (drawing up life like a host).
findings.evidence: Text: “roots of the ent[ire] ruling-power that the life of the living soul is drawn up through… from all the mountains, fields and islands” (¶20); “root of the trees… much great life coming up… being drawn up… like a great host” (¶21). The reading regains coherence here and translates largely by function (ascent, fastening, magnitude), with only mild uncertainty about “Cross,” not a narrative derailment.

findings.diagnosis: Genuine difficulty due to severe textual corruption (broken clauses, missing subjects, contradictory geography). The spiritual reading’s stumble is from damaged transmission, not a clear administrative insertion.
findings.evidence: Text is visibly corrupt: “What, however, is lesser… he takes up… the roots… they… Again… but the root of mankind… other than only this world of the south… Therefore… do not make… filling… small part…” The reading flags it: “severely corrupt… cannot be made coherent beyond this general sense.” Removing it would not restore a clear earlier narrative seam; it’s simply broken.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential close: mutual stirring/communication of bound roots; then the consequence when ‘Matter’ is crushed—internal war among members. Despite minor damage at the end, the functional teaching is intact and matches the conduit logic (interaction, transfer, destabilization).
findings.evidence: Text: “They stir one another, they draw life from one another through the action of the powers above” (¶23); “when the Matter… will be crushed… shall [war against] its members… overturn them… tear apart” (¶24). The reading reports the chapter “regains unity in ¶23–24,” indicating these belong to the substrate narrative and do not require governance/jurisdictional scaffolding to interpret.

textual_criticism.summary: 10 findings. Major disruptions: one administrative astrological overlay and its mythic expansion (¶10–16) best explained as insertion/expansion into an otherwise correspondential ‘three conduits’ lesson; recommend excising ¶10–16, plus the wheel-dependent stitch in ¶17. ¶18 is a damaged, schematic recap seam likely trying to reconcile the overlay with the triad; recommend annotating as a corrupt systematizing seam. The remaining core (¶1–9, ¶20–21, ¶23–24) is a coherent correspondential substrate; ¶22 is genuine heavy corruption (no excision).

harmonized_paragraphs.text: There are three conduits that exist through the entire zone, from the abyss to its heights.

The first conduit is the root of all the powers above, they that exist in all the heavens. They are cast off and fettered on the earths below; because the earth below is the ‘stripping off’, the garment and the body of the powers that are above the heavens.
For when the Father of Life constructed the heavenly worlds, he divested them of their bodies, [he] threw them to the earths below.

So, the upper worlds are of the soul and the spirit; but the worlds below are of the body and the carcass [of death] ⟨p.121⟩ Now as for this, he [fastened] the powers of heaven; he sealed it on their bodies and their carcasses that are on the earths, so that when life comes up from the fullness of these earths, it can be entirely drawn up to the heights in the roots of what is heavenly, that are fastened in their bodies. And also, all life can be purified in that place.

However, the waste that will be swept from the purified one who ascends to the heights will be let fall to the ground through the conduits of these conduits, and will be poured down [to the earths] and thrown to the underside.

This is the first conduit, which comes from the powers of the heavens to their bodies and their carcasses that are upon the earth; also, from their bodies and [their] carcasses that are on the earths to the powers of the heavens.

The second conduit is the one that comes from the temples and dwellings and cities that exist in the heavens down to the ground, to the five shapes of tree that grow upon the earth. The life comes up from the trees to the temples and cities. Life too, and the residue of the heavenly ones, comes down to the trees in a conduit.

And the third conduit is all the powers and householders who dwell in all the firmaments, whose roots come down from them to the five worlds of flesh that creep upon the earth, being fixed to one another. Now, the power and the life that shall be gathered in from the worlds of flesh are dispersed among them in various shapes. The powers above shall draw them to the upper side through conduits.

[The waste]te too, and the lust and the evil-doing and the anger that will be greater in the powers of [heaven]n, shall be poured to the ground through their various conduits. They shall be discharged upon mankind and the other remaining animals. When what is heavenly will wash the waste and the stench and the poison down on the creations of the flesh below, in their turn the creations shall be greater in lust and anger and evil-doing against each other through the action of their fathers who are on high.
However, the[se] other conduits that [the] Living Spirit has bound in the e[a]rths, they that the soul of the elements comes up through to the heavens;

Just as you have instructed us and put together this lesson on [the three conduits] you have told us about the prototype of the conduits. The first is the one that comes from the firmaments to the earths, and the one that comes from the wheel to the sea giant. That is only one. So, the other root is the one that comes [from]om [the temples] to the trees. The third is bound by means of the abortions in the f[fleshes]; also in the fleshes the fathers of the abortions who are in the heavens [above] are bound and twined, and the [y] that [are bound to them]

You have inquired about a [root] and you have asked about this lesson in superiority, great [and might] the earth from which much life ascends [from all] the Father of Life has drawn them. ⟨p.124⟩ He has fastened them from the powers [that] he has bound them in the earths. (These conduits) are the roots of the ent[ire] ruling-power that the life of the living soul is drawn up through, it coming up from the whole earth, from all the mountains, fields and islands.

After that first great root is the root of the trees, which is bound to the temples and the buildings above. For there also is much great life coming up from the tree and the entire Cross, being drawn up from them to the upper side like a great host.

What, however, is lesser [in comparison] of their conduit [than this] he takes up [in the places] the roots [also] the earths, they [of the roots] the whole earth in all the worlds. Again, these of the trees are present in the whole earth, whether small or great; but the root of mankind [in] is not present in the whole earth, other than only this world of the south. Therefore, even now these fleshes do not make [being in] in the entire world of the south [and filling] there is a small part of them in [of mankind] of the upper side of the world of the south in [and beasts] in number than the [others]

I have instructed you about the roots [and about the binding of] them, [I] have taught you that they are bound by their [roots in their orders] with one another. They stir one another, they draw life from one another through the action of the powers above, which stirs the nature that dwells in them all.

Now, when the Matter that is in them will be crushed and despoiled, then that Matter too shall [war against] its members and overturn them and [tear apart] each other [make them strike] stir [and the members] ⟨p.125⟩

changes_summary: Executed critic excisions per Finding 4 and Finding 5 by removing ¶10–12 and ¶13–16 in full (astrological ‘wheel of the stars’ digression and its mythic expansion). Executed the limited excision within ¶17 per Finding 6 by removing the wheel-dependent stitch (“those (conduits) are not bound to the wheel…”) and retaining only the correspondential core. ¶18 was left unchanged per Finding 7 (annotate only). All other paragraphs unchanged per findings marked none.
